page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9ae.48xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC 9T95 processors running at a baseline frequency of 2.25 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput inter-node communication. From a resource-density perspective, the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offers high compute density, making it a cost-efficient option for workloads that require massive parallel processing capabilities without the overhead of excess memory.

Given the 192 dedicated AMD EPYC cores and high-speed network interface, the ecs.c9ae.48xlarge is designed for compute-intensive workloads. Suitable use cases include high-performance computing (HPC), large-scale batch processing, video encoding, scientific modeling, and highly parallelized simulation tasks that do not require local storage or GPU acceleration.
